player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone Mastermind.
Ngone laa wara xélit koodu boobu di {code_length} xélit, xélit bu nekk ci 1 ba {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Ci sa réponse, ngone moo xélit ngi ci format bii: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Ci ginaaw gach xélit, ngone di naa ame feeback ci forme pegaar bu ñuul ak weex.
Pegaar bu ñuul mooy xélit bu doy ci poos bu doy, waaye pegaar bu weex mooy xélit bu doy ci poos bu baaxul.
Ngone {max_turns} tours ngi ci xélit koodu boobu.
player_prompt.with_repeats: ak li mën a am ay reewi

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dungeen tontu ci ay lim yu ñu séddoo ak benn dimbël, te nga boole leen ciy tëgg-tëggi.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ñépp a war di ay téere yu mat.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Tont bi wara am {code_length} limu ci biir.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Yëpp lim war na nekk diggante 1 ak {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Lim yu ñaari ñaari dul mën a nekk.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Danga xamee {guess}. Su ko defee, jéem a gis lu dul loolu.

game_action.feedback: Nga yóbb [{guess}]. Tekki: {black_pegs} kàddu ndaw, {white_pegs} kàddu weex.

outcome.win: Yaa ngi xélit koodu boobu, di naa xélit {black_pegs} ci {code_length} pegaar bu doy
outcome.turn_limit: Limite turn bi ngi génn. Yaa ngi xélit {percent} pour sant bu xélit bi.
